figures.analysis: 彭博「今日图表」标题：香港出生人数降至纪录低位，生育激励计划效果不佳。副题写截至2026年年中，香港一年出生人数首次降至3万以下。橙线为出生人数，纵轴约2万–10万，横轴约1998–2026年。2011年前后见约9.5万高点，其后台阶式回落，右端跌破3万。来源标注香港政府统计处、彭博。这是一条人口路径，不是当日恒生或A股收盘；与大中华「出生人数锐减」CLAIM并行阅读，不要把它当成今日买卖信号。

marketTone: The US Treasury said it will at least double buybacks of 10- to 30-year bonds from 9 September. Long-term yields fell, and the S&P 500 rose 0.2% — its first gain in four sessions. Fed minutes still say officials may need to tighten if inflation does not cool. Shanghai fell 2.4% even as Unitree jumped 460% on debut. Oil is a Middle East headline, not a confirmed flow shock.

summary.text: On 19 August the US Treasury said liquidity-support buybacks in the 10- to 20-year and 20- to 30-year sectors will rise from a $2 billion cap to at least $4 billion per operation, from 9 September through 4 November.

Wednesday’s US close (AP): S&P 500 7,707.98 (+0.2% / +16.22); Nasdaq 26,331.09 (+0.2% / +41.38); Dow 53,463.05 (+0.2% / +119.65). First gain in four days. CNBC: the 10-year yield closed at 4.647% (−5.7 bp) and the 30-year at 5.196% (−9 bp).

FOMC minutes for 28–29 July (released 19 August, 14:00 ET / 02:00 Beijing 20 August): many participants said tightening would likely be needed if inflation did not decline. The committee held the funds rate at 3½ to 3¾ percent; three members preferred a 25 bp hike. UK CPI was +2.9% y/y (ONS, in line with the desk’s 2.9% estimate). Euro-area HICP final was 2.9% (Eurostat; flash was 2.9%).

华尔街见闻 (year-dated): the Shanghai Composite closed at 3,894.42 (−2.40%) and the ChiNext at 3,473.49 (−6.26%). 财新: Unitree closed at 845 yuan (+460.34%). NBS July prints are still IP +4.5%, retail +0.6%, and Jan–Jul FAI −6.7%. 第一财经: on 19 August the PBOC did no 7-day reverse repos; overnight operations were 3,274亿元 (CNY327.4bn) against 4,697亿元 (CNY469.7bn) maturing — the last day of that overnight window.

signal: Read the long end as a scheduled buyback from 9 September, not as a Fed pivot: the same day’s minutes still leave a hike on the table if inflation stays high. A-shares are still the July demand miss; Unitree’s debut is one STAR name. Oil is a headline, not a Hormuz print.
watch: Philadelphia Fed and US jobless claims 20:30 Beijing · San Francisco Fed’s Daly on Bloomberg TV · Jackson Hole late August (Warsh) · first ≥$4bn buyback on 9 September · August NBS retail and FAI · 7-day OMO now that the overnight window has ended.

themeCards.title: The Treasury will at least double long-end buybacks, and yields fell
themeCards.fact: The Treasury will raise the cap on 10- to 20-year and 20- to 30-year liquidity-support buybacks from $2 billion to at least $4 billion per operation, from 9 September through 4 November. CNBC: the 10-year yield closed at 4.647% (−5.7 bp) and the 30-year at 5.196% (−9 bp). AP: the S&P 500 rose 0.2% to 7,707.98, the first gain in four days. Cointelegraph: bitcoin traded at $69,749 (+6%). Aug 20 市场一览: after the buyback news the curve flattened, long bonds outperformed, the Bloomberg dollar index fell to a three-month low, and gold jumped (desk/CLAIM).
themeCards.mechanism: This is a larger scheduled buyback from 9 September, not QE and not a cash close. Stocks, bitcoin, gold, and the dollar moved with duration on the same tape. CICC CLAIM (19 August 固收): overseas Treasuries may still swing at a high level in the near term, and the 30-year/10-year spread could widen further; the medium-term centre of gravity still points down.
themeCards.trigger: The first ≥$4 billion operation that fails to keep the 30-year yield down.
themeCards.invalidator: The 30-year yield back above its pre-announcement high with no size follow-through.

themeCards.title: Fed minutes still leave a hike on the table if inflation stays high
themeCards.fact: The 28–29 July minutes say many participants thought tightening would likely be needed if inflation did not decline, and some thought financial conditions might not be restrictive enough. The committee held the funds rate at 3½ to 3¾ percent; three members preferred a 25 bp hike. CNBC: the vote was 9–3; Chair Warsh discussed cutting FOMC meetings from eight a year to six, with no 2026 change. UK CPI was +2.9% y/y (in line). Euro-area HICP final was 2.9%.
themeCards.mechanism: Buybacks pulled the long end down on the same day the minutes kept a hike in reserve. Do not read the 30-year drop as a dovish committee. Jackson Hole is the next place to hear Warsh.
themeCards.trigger: Warsh language that restates a hike if inflation stays high into September.
themeCards.invalidator: A soft data run that retires hike odds without sending the 30-year back up.

themeCards.title: Unitree’s debut does not change China’s weak July demand
themeCards.fact: 财新: Unitree closed at 845 yuan, up 460.34%, valued at 3,417.72亿元 (CNY341.772bn). 见闻: Shanghai 3,894.42 (−2.40%); ChiNext 3,473.49 (−6.26%). NBS: July industrial production +4.5% y/y, retail sales +0.6%, Jan–Jul fixed-asset investment −6.7%. 第一财经: on 19 August the PBOC did no 7-day reverse repos; overnight operations were 3,274亿元 against 4,697亿元 maturing — the last day of that window. Inbox: Alibaba and NetEase report today; 今日图表 shows Hong Kong births below 30,000 for the first time (desk/CLAIM).
themeCards.mechanism: One STAR listing is not July retail sales. The overnight window has ended; a zero 7-day print is demand for funds, not an easing cycle. A-share beta stays the July miss until August retail and FAI reverse it. Hong Kong births are a long-horizon local story, not today’s CSI tape.
themeCards.trigger: August NBS prints that re-accelerate retail sales and FAI.
themeCards.invalidator: August prints that reverse the 0.6% / −6.7% miss.

themeCards.title: Oil is higher on Middle East tension, not on a confirmed Hormuz closure
themeCards.fact: 见闻: Brent $91.62 (+0.66%) and WTI $85.83 (+1.05%), a fourth up day and another three-week high (desk). Aug 20 市场一览: oil rose to a more-than three-week high because Middle East tension stayed high and US refiners ran more crude (CLAIM). That is not a dated Hormuz flow print.
themeCards.mechanism: A talks or isolation headline is not a Hormuz closure. Pair with the Brent row in Market closes; do not treat the desk’s “three-week high” as a settle.
themeCards.trigger: A confirmed strike on flows, or a dated ceasefire.
themeCards.invalidator: Quiet oil with no flow disruption.
